question: In a certain code language, ‘NULLIFY’ is written as ‘MFOLRUB’ and ‘SKYWALK’ is written as ‘HPBWZOP’. How will ‘FLAGGER’ be written in that language?
solution: The position of the English alphabet is given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] **Logic: ****Letters are coded as their opposite positional value.** ‘NULLIFY’ is written as ‘MFOLRUB’
